rows.evidence: Lint HL022 silent; widgets are all preset C.
Outer table fixed at 760 px for 2001.
HL020 silent; theme colors on the web-safe cube.
Verdana and Book Antiqua stacks only.
Shared border tables, nested product tour table, bordered catalog table.
Program window screenshots as small GIFs; no photos or SVG.
All 12 required C widgets plus hit counter and placeholder marked.
No glitter, webring, or starry tile.
Brochure voice: Welcome to our Web site!, Click here, Copyright with All rights reserved.
Left shared border of hover-swap buttons plus bottom text links.
Logo, violet theme, and product structure carry the brand.
Most of the IA mapped; the modern Log in has no period equivalent on the site (no Registration component page).
webbot comments, GENERATOR and theme meta tags, period swap script.
Timestamp line, odometer counter, [Hit Counter] placeholder on the pricing page.
Text badge names IE 5 at 800 x 600, matching the 2001 target browser without a logo.
One NEW graphic plus a text box ticker that pauses in Safe Mode.
No audio on this build; nothing autoplays, which the preset allows.
Safe Mode verified on both pages; ticker reads window.homesteadSafe.
Alt text, labeled form fields, hover swaps mirrored on focus and blur, text-only page.
Asset log covers every file and records the GENERATOR tag as descriptive use.
